scores.claim_text: OneStream has built a proprietary, AI-enabled and extensible software platform (Digital Finance Cloud) with applied AI/ML since 2016 and a proprietary data-model approach.
scores.interpretation: CPM/finance SaaS firms compete on platform/data-model engineering, not patented IP, and the filing makes NO numeric patent claim. USPTO is the wrong registry here (Calibration H1 sector-registry match; H7 only fires on the Nikola pattern of a LARGE patent claim with ~0 in-area grants). Zero granted patents is fully consistent with a real $374.9M-revenue SaaS platform whose existence is independently evidenced by paying-customer revenue and a third-party implementation ecosystem (see OS5). UNVERIFIABLE, not a contradiction.

scores.claim_text: OneStream entered a five-year $300.0M consumption agreement (June 2022) for data center/cloud/IT services; $236.7M remained as of March 31, 2024.
scores.M_value: 0 hits across all 3 hyperscaler megacaps; raw signal=INFLATION_SUSPECT
scores.interpretation: The raw INFLATION_SUSPECT signal is a FALSE POSITIVE under Calibration H5/H8. The cloud vendor is OneStream's SUPPLIER (the filing does not even name it), and a $300M commitment is immaterial to a $200B+-revenue hyperscaler that does not disclose individual customers in 10-Ks. Absence of OneStream in megacap filings is expected and is NOT evidence the commitment is fabricated - the $236.7M remaining obligation is an audited financial-statement line. No registry independently covers a private cloud-consumption contract. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: OneStream is controlled/backed by KKR; the Amended LLC Agreement contains provisions in favor of KKR and its affiliates.
scores.M_value: 9 hits in KKR's own 10-K/10-Q filings (2021-2024), incl. FY2023 10-K and Q1-2024 10-Q
scores.interpretation: Counterparty disclosure directly corroborates the KKR sponsor relationship: KKR & Co. names OneStream in nine of its own SEC filings spanning 2021-2024, exactly the cadence expected for a held portfolio company. Independent registry (the counterparty's own filings) confirms the material relationship. PASS.

scores.claim_text: More than 1,300 OneStream employees are working across the globe.
scores.M_value: 0 LCA filings; signal=NO_LCA_FOOTPRINT. NOTE: DOL dataset window is only 2024-07-01..2024-09-30 (a single quarter)
scores.interpretation: The DOL OFLC slice available here covers only one quarter (Q3-2024), so it cannot ground-truth a cumulative >1,300 GLOBAL headcount claim - most of which is non-US (AU/EU/SG offices) and outside any US federal registry, and even US H-1B sponsorship is bursty quarter-to-quarter and may file under the LLC EIN. Absence in a one-quarter US H-1B snapshot is NOT informative for a global headcount claim (Calibration: registry coverage gap). UNVERIFIABLE rather than manufactured underdelivery.

scores.claim_text: Dozens of OneStream customers - including some of the largest manufacturers, distributors and retailers - use its applied ML; diversified base with no customer >10% of revenue.
scores.M_value: 61 hits across independent third-party filers: The Hackett Group (HCKT, repeated 10-K/8-K), Five9 (FIVN), Tenneco 10-K exhibit, et al.
scores.interpretation: Independent third-party SEC filers repeatedly reference OneStream - notably The Hackett Group (a public CPM/EPM consultancy) names it as an implementation/alliance platform across multiple years, and an enterprise (Tenneco) references it in a 10-K exhibit. This is strong ecosystem-level corroboration that OneStream is a real, widely-adopted CPM platform with a genuine large-enterprise customer/partner base, consistent with the 'dozens of large customers' and diversified-base disclosure. PASS.

scores.claim_text: OneStream reported $374.9M FY2023 revenue (up from $279.3M FY2022) and $918.1M of remaining performance obligations as of March 31, 2024.
scores.M_check: no external registry covers audited SaaS revenue / RPO
scores.M_value: n/a - figures are from audited GAAP financial statements within the prospectus
scores.interpretation: Audited revenue and ASC 606 RPO are accounting figures with no independent federal registry to corroborate (Calibration H8: SaaS ARR/RPO are not in any registry). They are internally consistent (geographic revenue subtotals tie to totals; YoY growth ~34%) and the company is audited, but the framework cannot independently verify them. UNVERIFIABLE - and these are exactly the LOW-discriminative accounting claims the rubric down-weights.

scores.claim_text: OneStream founders previously built UpStream (acquired by Hyperion -> Hyperion FDM) and HFM, the de facto CPM standard before Oracle's acquisition.
scores.M_check: no registry covers pre-2012 product/M&A founder history; CT not applicable
scores.M_value: n/a - historical narrative about Hyperion/Oracle-era products predating the company
scores.interpretation: A founder-pedigree narrative about 2000s-era Hyperion products (FDM/HFM) and their acquisition by Oracle is not recorded in any of the available registries (USPTO/USAspending/EPA/CT.gov/openFDA are all sector-irrelevant), and the events predate OneStream's 2012 formation. Not a discriminative or verifiable claim under any available M-source. UNVERIFIABLE.
